selected_evidence.summary: Captured RHEL/kernel versions, installed runtime versions, port/account state, PAM integration, firewall, SELinux, SSH, and protected configuration checksums.
Proves the service is enabled and active under inventory-api, listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, is permitted persistently by firewalld, and returns healthy JSON through NODE_IP before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: batchworker limited to 128 MB virtual memory per process without interrupting API
selected_evidence.summary: Shows 131072 KiB soft/hard limits, a denied 200 MiB allocation, unchanged API PID, and healthy API responses both before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel preserved
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 match before and after the work.

Healthy baseline boot ID 180a78a0-8a84-45ff-82f1-cd734208a369, acknowledged safe reboot, changed boot ID 7ed760ad-4327-4e86-ba15-44be53f4478a, and full recovery of API, limits, firewall, SSH, SELinux, configuration checksums, and zero failed units.

commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /opt/inventory-api/inventory_api.py <<'ANTRIEB_API_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
import socket
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

class InventoryHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "inventory-api"
    sys_version = ""

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            status = 200
            body = {"service": "inventory-api", "status": "ok"}
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            status = 200
            body = {"service": "inventory-api", "node": socket.gethostname(), "items": []}
        else:
            status = 404
            body = {"error": "not found"}
        payload = json.dumps(body, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(payload)

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), InventoryHandler).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_API_EOF
chown root:root /opt/inventory-api/inventory_api.py
chmod 0755 /opt/inventory-api/inventory_api.py
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-api

WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/inventory-api
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-api/inventory_api.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
TimeoutStopSec=10s
UMask=0027
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6
SystemCallArchitectures=native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF

chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service
cat > /etc/security/limits.d/90-batchworker.conf <<'ANTRIEB_LIMIT_EOF'
